cells.gaps: No cumulative total of mairies on the national administration network is published: 12 is the number added in 2024, beside 77 communes, and the same source names no system the staff work in over it. The facts disagree in three places: the newest authorities fact (BEN-021, count:1, Parakou in e-Foncier) and the systems facts state no connection; Bantè is called a pioneer commune still to be connected in July 2026 (BEN-003, BEN-005); and the newest last12 fact (BEN-001, regressing) is a one-day failure in Cotonou's arrondissement offices, sub-offices that do not carry the tier, while the newest finance fact (BEN-007) states nothing against the 2024 sovereign-issue line (BEN-025).
cells.note: Twelve town halls used the services of the state's network in 2024, an institutional connection live beyond the capital, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with its denominator, and 12 additions in one year with no cumulative total is a floor.
